vehicleTypeReason: The pack includes law-enforcement metadata like police plate probabilities, siren settings, and police-style light/siren extras, indicating a police vehicle.

security.summary: This looks like a normal data-only vehicle pack: model and texture assets plus vehicle metadata. The included fxmanifest.lua only declares static files/data_file entries and does not load scripts or web content. No executable behavior, remote access, obfuscation, or hidden payloads is evident.

repairs.issue: Uses wildcard metadata paths that may reference files outside the actually present set.
repairs.action: Importer will omit stale or missing declarations and generate a fresh manifest from the discovered vehicle assets and metadata only.

remediation.summary: Quarantine the runtime Lua scripts so only data-only vehicle assets remain for re-scan.

actions.reason: Runtime Lua script is outside the accepted data-only vehicle pack scope and removing it eliminates executable content.
Runtime Lua content is not eligible for import; quarantining it removes executable behavior from the pack.
